rationale: The core statistical approach is exactly right for the design: a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, with time kept categorical to allow non-linear trajectories, and it explicitly rejects a series of pairwise contrasts. QC is the weak point: sample-ID reconciliation and a condition x time cross-tabulation are specified, but there is no PCA, sample-distance or library-size inspection colored by condition/batch and no outlier policy, only a passing note that DESeq2 outlier defaults remain on. The low-count filter (sum >= 10) is minimal and stated; normalization is implicitly handled by DESeq2 size factors from raw integer counts (explicitly not pre-normalized), but the size-factor step is never named. Multiple testing is BH at a stated alpha 0.05 set a priori with an explicit no-post-hoc-relaxation rule, yet the plan asks for log2FoldChange from interaction coefficients without any shrinkage (lfcShrink/apeglm) and never specifies the per-time-point fold-change description the reference expects; also, the retained-LFC-with-LRT semantics are left ambiguous. Enrichment is well specified with a named, versioned WikiPathways GMT and a correct expressed-gene universe, though no gene-set size window is given; reporting covers design, thresholds and gene counts but omits software versions and a discussion of the n=3 power/design caveats.
